reasons.UNCLEAR: The question or an option is unclear

results.intro: Only you can see this. Your first answer to each question counts.
results.empty: You haven’t answered any question yet.

reportStatus.RESOLVED: dealt with: the question was changed
reportStatus.DISMISSED: dealt with: the question stays as it is

editor.typeFixed: The type can’t be changed after the item is created.
editor.author: Author
editor.cmeHint: Shown only. Points aren’t tracked yet.
editor.linkHint: Where it is hosted, for example on YouTube or Vimeo. It opens there.
editor.filesHint: PDF, Word or PowerPoint, up to 25 MB each.

editor.readOnly: This item can’t be edited in its current state.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.saveFirst: Save the course before adding lessons.

actions.title: Review and publishing
actions.takeDownHint: The item is hidden until it is reviewed and published again.

questions.title: Exam questions
questions.optionsHint: Between 2 and 6. Mark the one right answer, and explain every option: why it is right, or why it is wrong.
questions.draftNote: A question is shown to readers only after a reviewer has checked and published it.
questions.referencesHint: What the right answer rests on: a guideline, a paper or a book. Readers see them with the explanation.
questions.sourceHint: For the reviewer only, for example “written new by …”. Questions are never copied from board exams or question banks.

statistics.title: How readers answered
statistics.tooFew: Shown once at least {count} people answered, so nobody can be picked out.
statistics.summary: {answered} people answered; {percent}% right the first time.
statistics.openReports: {count, plural, one {One report waiting} other {# reports waiting}}

import.title: Import questions
import.intro: Load many questions at once from a spreadsheet. Each one arrives as a draft and goes through the usual review; nothing is published by the import. If any row has a problem, nothing is loaded, and every problem is listed.
import.step1: Download the template and open it in Excel:
import.step2: Write one question per row. Required: the question, at least two options, the number of the right one, and where it comes from.
import.step3: Save it as “CSV UTF-8” and choose the file below.
import.keysIntro: topic: one of the keys below, or empty. level: STUDENT, RESIDENT, FELLOW, SPECIALIST or EXPERT, or empty for all levels. difficulty: EASY, MEDIUM or HARD, or empty. correct: the number of the right option (1 to 6).
import.encoding: The Hebrew in this file can’t be read. In Excel, choose Save as, then “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)”, and try again.
import.imported: {count, plural, one {One question was imported as a draft.} other {# questions were imported as drafts.}}
import.refused: {count, plural, one {Nothing was imported: one problem.} other {Nothing was imported: # problems.}}

codes.importBadFile: The file can’t be read: a quote mark opens a field and never closes it.
codes.importMissingColumn: This column is missing from the first row.
codes.importUnknownColumn: The first row has a column the template doesn’t have.
codes.importTooManyRows: At most 500 questions in one file.
codes.importUnknownTopic: No such topic. Use a topic key from the list.
codes.importUnknownLevel: No such level. Use STUDENT, RESIDENT, FELLOW, SPECIALIST or EXPERT, or leave it empty.
codes.importUnknownDifficulty: No such difficulty. Use EASY, MEDIUM or HARD, or leave it empty.
codes.importOptionTextRequired: An explanation without its option’s text.
codes.importOptionGap: Options must follow each other: 1, 2, 3, with none skipped.
codes.importOptionCount: A question needs between 2 and 6 options.
codes.importCorrectRequired: Give the number of the right option.
codes.importCorrectUnknown: There is no option with this number.
codes.importBadUrl: Not a web address (it must start with https:// or http://).
codes.importReferenceTitleRequired: A reference’s address needs its title.
codes.importSourceRequired: Say where the question comes from.

reports.title: Readers’ reports
reports.intro: What readers say is wrong with a question. You don’t see who sent a report; your answer goes to them. To change or take down the question, open it.

outcomes.RESOLVED: The question was corrected or taken down
outcomes.DISMISSED: The question stays as it is

reports.responseHint: They see it in their results and get a notice.

mock.title: Mock exam
mock.intro: A timed exam on the topics you choose. You see the answers and explanations only at the end.
mock.topicsHint: Leave all unticked for every topic.
mock.rules: You have 90 seconds a question, counted by the server. You can move between questions and change an answer until the time is up; then the exam ends by itself. Fewer questions are given if fewer match.
mock.none: You haven’t sat a mock exam yet.
mock.unanswered: {count, plural, =0 {You answered every question.} one {One question was left unanswered.} other {# questions were left unanswered.}}
mock.minutesLeft: {count, plural, one {One minute left.} other {# minutes left.}}
mock.confirm: End the exam now and see your result?
mock.confirmUnanswered: {count, plural, one {One question is unanswered. End the exam now anyway?} other {# questions are unanswered. End the exam now anyway?}}
